_note: Tool names, descriptions, parameters and annotations copied from the real server. Neither this project's author nor its classifier had seen these tools before this batch was measured.

tools.name: d1_databases_list
tools.description: List all of the D1 databases in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: d1_database_create
tools.description: Create a new D1 database in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: d1_database_delete
tools.description: Delete a d1 database in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: d1_database_get
tools.description: Get a D1 database in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: d1_database_query
tools.description: Query a D1 database in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: r2_buckets_list
tools.description: List r2 buckets in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: r2_bucket_create
tools.description: Create a new r2 bucket in your Cloudflare account

tools.name: r2_bucket_get
tools.description: Get details about a specific R2 bucket

tools.name: workers_builds_list_builds
tools.description: Use the Workers Builds API to list builds for a Cloudflare Worker. workerId is required. Use workers_list to find a Worker's ID when needed.

tools.name: workers_builds_get_build
tools.description: Get details for a specific build by its UUID. Includes build and deploy commands for the build (useful for debugging build failures).

tools.name: workers_builds_get_build_logs
tools.description: Get logs for a Cloudflare Workers build by its explicit UUID.

tools.name: workers_list
tools.description: List all Workers in your Cloudflare account. If you only need details of a single Worker, use workers_get_worker.

tools.name: workers_get_worker
tools.description: Get the details of the Cloudflare Worker.

tools.name: workers_get_worker_code
tools.description: Get the source code of a Cloudflare Worker. Note: This may be a bundled version of the worker.

tools.name: zones_list
tools.description: List all zones under a Cloudflare account

tools.name: zone_details
tools.description: Get details for a specific Cloudflare zone
